text_markup: The Runner is breaching Archives during a run made with {card:Immolation Script}. They choose a piece of ice from the set of candidates, and apply {card:Immolation Script}'s replacement effect to trash another card instead of accessing the chosen ice. After resolving this, the chosen ice is no longer a candidate and cannot be accessed again this breach. (The newly-trashed card, however, could be a candidate.)
